dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Phew, it's been a while since I unleashed my lightning during Windblume.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Unleashing lightning on people? Haha, no, no. Once in a while, maybe. It sure feels good to let loose, though...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hah, my old Professor even wrote to me about that a few days ago. Of course, I made sure to emphasize that I always "treat others with kindness."

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's only natural for a student to inherit their teacher's ways, after all, and mine was a gentle old man from the Spantamad school.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: So, you see? This time, I only used gentle methods of electrocution. So gentle, even Jean would have no reason to intervene.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You seem to be in good spirits, Miss Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah, well, it's good to move about every once in a while.
